# Finite quantum gravity v6: derived premises and a one-loop check (v2.1.0)

Manuscript v6 of "Finite quantum gravity from a scale-invariant gas of branes" (`uv-finite/`, 47 pages).
- The single-brane factor is derived from a cell model of the brane; fine graining is shown necessary for a finite vacuum energy.
- A one-loop graph in closed form obeys the cutting rule exactly and overtakes the tree amplitude between 1.4M and 1.9M for n = 4.
- Checks: 195 Python, 84 C, 114 Julia, 17 Lean 4 theorems, all run in CI.

Assets: paper PDF, LaTeX source (tex.zip), arXiv package (tar.gz), all 16 figures (figures.zip).
